svg.text: No service-account key, no stored secret: the repository has zero Actions secrets; its variables are identifiers only. Neither pull requests nor any other workflow can become a service account.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A workflow file that is not in the bindings is refused for both identities · deploy.yml dispatched from a branch fails at auth · an UNSIGNED image and an image validly signed by a DIFFERENT identity are both refused

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: at 'Verify signature' with production untouched · the genuine image passes the same workflow · re-pushing an existing tag is refused. NOT proven: a different repository being rejected by gate 1 (needs a second repo).

svg.text: Pull requests run ci.yml, which has no id-token permission: it cannot obtain a Google token even from a fork

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: release.yml signs the pushed digest with its job identity (Fulcio certificate, Rekor entry) and attaches a CycloneDX SBOM and SLSA provenance

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The build job presents GitHub's OIDC token to Google STS; the provider's condition accepts only this repository (by numeric id) and owner

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Only the principal release.yml@refs/heads/main may impersonate kcs-publisher

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The publisher pushes the image; tags are immutable, so a tag can never be repointed

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: deploy.yml presents its own OIDC token; its job_workflow_ref is deploy.yml@refs/heads/main

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Only that principal may impersonate kcs-deployer, whose roles are scoped to the one service and the registry (read)

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The deployer ships image@digest, then smoke-tests the private service with an identity token

svg.text: Before deploying, deploy.yml verifies signature, SBOM attestation and SLSA provenance against the expected workflow identity

svg.text: Verification pins certificate identity and issuer, so a valid signature from any other identity is refused
